faq.q: Can I just use Google Translate on my site?
faq.a: For rough comprehension, maybe. For anything customer-facing, no. Machine translation of marketing copy reads as machine translation, and that damages trust in exactly the market you are trying to win.

faq.q: Does an Arabic version help SEO?
faq.a: Yes, if implemented with separate URLs and hreflang. You become eligible for Arabic search results, which are far less competitive than English in most categories here.
Whichever your customers actually use. In Saudi that is usually Arabic; in Dubai it is often English. Design for the primary language first and adapt to the second.
